text: Which subgroups of G arise as kernels of group homomorphisms out of G?
explanation: Kernels are always normal (φ(gng⁻¹) = φ(g)e φ(g)⁻¹ = e), and conversely every normal subgroup N is the kernel of the canonical projection G → G/N. This is why normality is exactly the condition needed for quotient groups.
